on_error a connection error means the service crashed: it restarts and resumes the SAME episode (never a reset) in the state after the last call it completed, which you may not have received. Wait until GET /status answers again (rcb_client: Robot.wait_ready(); resuming replays the episode so far, which can take minutes in a long episode, and the wall clock keeps running), then check calls and control_steps before you continue. A 500 means the simulator failed: the episode is over (reason "error"). A call that runs longer than max_call_wall_s seconds stops at the next control step and returns what it executed (meta.stopped, executed_rows).
